This particular elemental seems to have been placed in Lower Guk so as to stop explorers who might by trying to waltz into the king room with good faction.

He attacks everything on sight (except frogloks). If you fight the Elemental, the nearby frogloks will come to his aid.

Its name is spelled "'''an''' huge water elemental" (see screenshot).
